description: This Java source file defines the EntityGroupUtil class, which provides utility methods for managing entity groups within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to retrieve entity names by group and to filter model entities based on inclusion/exclusion rules and stamp fields.

classes.name: EntityGroupUtil
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for entity group management, including retrieving entity names by group and filtering model entities based on inclusion rules.

methods.name: getEntityNamesByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a set of entity names belonging to a specified entity group, considering stamp fields if required.

methods.name: getModelEntitiesFromRecords
methods.description: Filters and returns a list of ModelEntity objects based on inclusion/exclusion rules and stamp field requirements.
